title: Getting Started & System Requirements
summary: Install node-pptx-templater, configure Node.js runtimes, and understand the zero-native-dependency architecture.

sections.heading: Architecture Overview
sections.text: node-pptx-templater is a 100% pure JavaScript OpenXML presentation engine built specifically for Node.js (>=20.12.0) and Serverless environments. Unlike legacy solutions that require spawning LibreOffice, Java runtimes (POI), or headless Chromium browsers, node-pptx-templater directly reads and mutates the internal OpenXML ZIP container in memory with zero C++ addons or binary dependencies.

sections.heading: Installation
sections.text: Install via your package manager of choice:
sections.code:
# Using npm
npm install node-pptx-templater

# Using pnpm
pnpm add node-pptx-templater

# Using yarn
yarn add node-pptx-templater

sections.heading: Dual ESM and CommonJS Support
sections.text: The library is packaged with first-class TypeScript declarations (.d.ts) and supports both CommonJS require() and modern ESM import syntax out of the box without bundler configuration.

sections.heading: Why Traditional Tools Fail on Serverless
sections.text: Traditional PowerPoint automation tools rely on LibreOffice CLI (which requires a 500MB+ Docker image, takes 15+ seconds to boot, and consumes 1GB+ RAM) or Java-based Apache POI. node-pptx-templater has a pure JavaScript footprint under 2MB, boots in <15ms, and runs entirely in memory without writing temporary files to /tmp.

title: Run Fragment Healing & Anti-Corruption Engine
summary: Overcoming PowerPoint split <a:r> text run fragmentation at the AST level without regex bugs.

sections.heading: The Fragmented Run Problem Explained
sections.text:
When a human types "{{COMPANY_NAME}}" into PowerPoint, spellcheckers, auto-correct, or grammar tools frequently break that single placeholder across multiple disjoint XML nodes. In the raw PresentationML, it becomes:

<a:p>
  <a:r><a:t>{{COMP</a:t></a:r>
  <a:r><a:rPr b="1"/><a:t>ANY_</a:t></a:r>
  <a:r><a:t>NAME}}</a:t></a:r>
</a:p>

Naive search-and-replace regex engines fail completely because "{{COMPANY_NAME}}" does not exist in any single text node.

sections.heading: How node-pptx-templater Heals Runs
sections.text: node-pptx-templater implements an AST-level paragraph normalizer. It analyzes all <a:r> child elements within each <a:p> paragraph, constructs a virtual coordinate map of the text, detects placeholder boundaries spanning multiple runs, merges the text while preserving typography styles (bold, font size, color, language), and prunes the emptied sibling nodes cleanly. Result: 100% replacement accuracy with zero layout deformation.

title: Excel Dual-Sync: Preventing Repair Presentation Warnings
summary: Synchronizing DrawingML <c:chartSpace> and embedded .xlsx workbook data caches.

sections.heading: Why Other Libraries Cause "Repair Presentation" Prompts
sections.text:
In Microsoft PowerPoint, native charts are dual-layered:
1. The chart visual representation is defined in XML: ppt/charts/chart1.xml (<c:chartSpace>).
2. The underlying data source is stored as an embedded binary Excel workbook: ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet1.xlsx.

When standard open-source libraries only update the XML <c:strCache> or <c:numCache>, Microsoft Office detects a desynchronization between the visual cache and the binary Excel spreadsheet when a user clicks "Edit Data in Excel". PowerPoint then throws the infamous error:
"PowerPoint found a problem with content in presentation.pptx. PowerPoint can attempt to repair the presentation."

sections.heading: The Dual-Sync Solution
sections.text:
node-pptx-templater synchronizes BOTH layers simultaneously:
- It mutates the DrawingML <c:ser>, <c:cat>, and <c:val> series cache trees.
- It parses and updates the embedded .xlsx sheet XML (sheet1.xml) and shared strings table within the internal ZIP package.
When the recipient opens the deck in PowerPoint or clicks "Edit Data in Excel", the numbers, series, and formulas match 100% with zero repair prompts.

title: Dynamic Tables, Row Merging & Auto-Pagination
summary: Handling complex rowspan/gridspan cell merges, row striping, and auto-pagination across slide overflows.

sections.heading: Row Merging & Nested Data
sections.text: Standard OpenXML tables can be easily corrupted if vertical merge (vMerge) or horizontal merge (hMerge) attributes are mismatched. node-pptx-templater automatically manages grid coordinates, span calculations, and cell hiding rules.

sections.heading: Auto-Pagination with splitTableOnOverflow
sections.text: When dynamically generating tables with 50+ rows from database records, tables frequently spill off the bottom of the slide. splitTableOnOverflow calculates row heights, detects boundary collisions, deep-clones the parent slide, repeats header rows, and paginates rows cleanly across subsequent slides.

title: Z-Order Stacking & Spatial Geometry Engine
summary: Precise layer stacking, bounding box transformations, and English Metric Unit (EMU) alignment.

sections.heading: Understanding OpenXML Coordinates (EMU)
sections.text: In PowerPoint, coordinates are stored in English Metric Units (1 inch = 914,400 EMUs; 1 cm = 360,000 EMUs; 1 pt = 12,700 EMUs). node-pptx-templater includes a high-precision spatial unit engine to prevent floating-point drift.
